findings.message: Every error from `Rename` becomes a 500, so renaming an unknown id returns 500 instead of 404. `Rename` also never checks whether the UPDATE touched a row, so a missing widget only shows up as a generic error from the follow-up lookup.

`Rename` ignores `RowsAffected` and runs the UPDATE and the re-read outside a transaction. A missing id cannot be told apart from other failures, and a concurrent update or delete between the two statements can return a different result than the rename wrote.

criteria.note: Implemented, but no tests cover the rename endpoint.
An unknown id falls into the generic error branch and returns 500. Nothing maps a not-found result to 404.
